    The
    2026 MLB Opening Day game between the Pittsburgh Pirates and New York Mets on Thursday, March 26, 2026, starts at 1:15 p.m. ET, broadcasting nationally on NBC and streaming on Peacock. Regional coverage for weekend games is available on SNY and SportsNet Pittsburgh, with out-of-market options on MLB.TV. 
    Key Streaming & TV Options: 
    • Live TV: NBC
    • Streaming Services: Peacock, DIRECTV Stream, YouTube TV
    • Regional Networks: SNY (Mets), SportsNet Pittsburgh (Pirates)
    • Official League App: MLB.TV 
    The game can also be heard on Audacy Mets Radio (WHSQ 880AM).
